g.text: Title: NIVA pod | Controller, acquisition, power, insert interface | Rev C

g.desc: Title: NIVA pod | Controller, acquisition, power, insert interface | Rev C

g.text: NOT FOR FABRICATION. Values, protection and layout require bench validation.

g.desc: NOT FOR FABRICATION. Values, protection and layout require bench validation.

g.text: 03 POWER FROM REMOVABLE CARTRIDGE (NO CHARGER ON THIS BOARD)

g.desc: 03 POWER FROM REMOVABLE CARTRIDGE (NO CHARGER ON THIS BOARD)

g.text: J2: 2 x VBAT + 2 x GND spring contacts land on pads on the cartridge lid. Cell protection (e.g. BQ2970) lives in

g.desc: J2: 2 x VBAT + 2 x GND spring contacts land on pads on the cartridge lid. Cell protection (e.g. BQ2970) lives in

g.text: Force channel: FSR from VEXC to Fn_RAW, 10k to GND, 3.3k + 1 uF low-pass (fc = 48 Hz) to the ADC. The 1 uF reservoir

g.desc: Force channel: FSR from VEXC to Fn_RAW, 10k to GND, 3.3k + 1 uF low-pass (fc = 48 Hz) to the ADC. The 1 uF reservoir

g.text: is ~50,000x the MCP3208 sample capacitor, so acquisition settling is set by the RC, not the ADC source-impedance limit.

g.desc: is ~50,000x the MCP3208 sample capacitor, so acquisition settling is set by the RC, not the ADC source-impedance limit.

g.text: Divider output is NOT the Tekscan A201 op-amp reference circuit and does not inherit its linearity or drift figures.

g.desc: Divider output is NOT the Tekscan A201 op-amp reference circuit and does not inherit its linearity or drift figures.

g.text: C5 at VDD pin 8, C20 at VDDIO pin 5. SDx/SCx tied to GND, OCS_Aux/SDO_Aux and INT2 open,

g.desc: C5 at VDD pin 8, C20 at VDDIO pin 5. SDx/SCx tied to GND, OCS_Aux/SDO_Aux and INT2 open,

g.text: J3 pin 1 is sense-only for the jig. The jig must NOT back-feed +3V3 into the regulator output; power from the cartridge.

g.desc: J3 pin 1 is sense-only for the jig. The jig must NOT back-feed +3V3 into the regulator output; power from the cartridge.

g.text: IO21 is U0TXD: the ROM boot log will flicker the green emitter at reset. Accepted for the prototype; firmware logs via USB.

g.desc: IO21 is U0TXD: the ROM boot log will flicker the green emitter at reset. Accepted for the prototype; firmware logs via USB.

g.text: IO9 = BOOT strap (10k pull-up, pulled low only by the service jig). IO8 = strap pull-up, otherwise a spare pin.

g.desc: IO9 = BOOT strap (10k pull-up, pulled low only by the service jig). IO8 = strap pull-up, otherwise a spare pin.

g.text: IO1 IMU_INT1, IO4/5/6 SPI SCK/MISO/MOSI, IO7 CS_ADC, IO10 CS_IMU, IO20 LED_R, IO21 LED_G, IO18/19 USB (service only).

g.desc: IO1 IMU_INT1, IO4/5/6 SPI SCK/MISO/MOSI, IO7 CS_ADC, IO10 CS_IMU, IO20 LED_R, IO21 LED_G, IO18/19 USB (service only).

g.text: GPIO map (Rev C review of Rev B): IO0 I2C_SDA, IO2 I2C_SCL (strap: 4.7k pull-up keeps it high at reset), IO3 BUTTON,

g.desc: GPIO map (Rev C review of Rev B): IO0 I2C_SDA, IO2 I2C_SCL (strap: 4.7k pull-up keeps it high at reset), IO3 BUTTON,

g.text: IMU is placed near a board screw for rigidity; axis orientation recorded on the PCB silk.

g.desc: IMU is placed near a board screw for rigidity; axis orientation recorded on the PCB silk.

g.text: 04 PASSIVE INSERT INTERFACE / FIVE DIVIDER CHANNELS (BENCH TOPOLOGY, NOT A201 REFERENCE CIRCUIT)

g.desc: 04 PASSIVE INSERT INTERFACE / FIVE DIVIDER CHANNELS (BENCH TOPOLOGY, NOT A201 REFERENCE CIRCUIT)

g.text: J3 sits on the board underside and is reached through the empty cartridge bay. It has no charging function.

g.desc: J3 sits on the board underside and is reached through the empty cartridge bay. It has no charging function.

g.text: NIVA POD / CONTROLLER + ACQUISITION / REV C ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.desc: NIVA POD / CONTROLLER + ACQUISITION / REV C ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.text: Excitation is continuous (Rev B decision kept): switching it every 5 ms cannot settle a 3.3 ms RC. R33 = 220R limits a tail

g.desc: Excitation is continuous (Rev B decision kept): switching it every 5 ms cannot settle a 3.3 ms RC. R33 = 220R limits a tail

g.text: No TVS is fitted; the RC networks are the protection. System-level IEC 61000-4-2 testing is still required.

g.desc: No TVS is fitted; the RC networks are the protection. System-level IEC 61000-4-2 testing is still required.

g.text: ESD at J1: every force/ID line reaches the ADC through 3.3k into a 1 uF reservoir (8 kV HBM = 0.8 uC -> ~0.8 V step).

g.desc: ESD at J1: every force/ID line reaches the ADC through 3.3k into a 1 uF reservoir (8 kV HBM = 0.8 uC -> ~0.8 V step).

g.text: which cancels exactly because the ADC reference (pin 15) is the same VEXC node (MCP3208 IREF <= 150 uA -> <= 33 mV).

g.desc: which cancels exactly because the ADC reference (pin 15) is the same VEXC node (MCP3208 IREF <= 150 uA -> <= 33 mV).

g.text: VEXC: ~2048 nominal, rising as VEXC sags, full scale on a tail short (fault flag).

g.desc: VEXC: ~2048 nominal, rising as VEXC sags, full scale on a tail short (fault flag).

g.text: the cartridge; charging, NTC and pack ID belong to the separate dock (not designed here).

g.desc: the cartridge; charging, NTC and pack ID belong to the separate dock (not designed here).

g.text: C4 at VDD pin 16, C19 at VREF pin 15. VREF = VEXC (the excitation node itself), so force, ID and

g.desc: C4 at VDD pin 16, C19 at VREF pin 15. VREF = VEXC (the excitation node itself), so force, ID and

g.text: Dropout check: TLV755P max dropout 238 mV at 500 mA (datasheet); scale roughly with load. ESP-NOW/Wi-Fi TX bursts can

g.desc: Dropout check: TLV755P max dropout 238 mV at 500 mA (datasheet); scale roughly with load. ESP-NOW/Wi-Fi TX bursts can

g.text: reach a few hundred mA, so cell IR + contact resistance + dropout set the usable cut-off. Firmware must stop recording

g.desc: reach a few hundred mA, so cell IR + contact resistance + dropout set the usable cut-off. Firmware must stop recording

g.text: at a gauge-reported threshold set from measured sag (bench item P1). C6 input, C7/C8 + C2/C3 output bulk.

g.desc: at a gauge-reported threshold set from measured sag (bench item P1). C6 input, C7/C8 + C2/C3 output bulk.

g.text: piezo readings are ratiometric in hardware: no firmware normalisation. CH6 reads +3V3/2 against

g.desc: piezo readings are ratiometric in hardware: no firmware normalisation. CH6 reads +3V3/2 against

g.text: per ST datasheet pin table (confirm against DS13210 rev before release).

g.desc: per ST datasheet pin table (confirm against DS13210 rev before release).

g.text: short to 15 mA / 0.05 W (22R would dissipate 0.5 W in an 0603). VEXC sags to ~2.94 V at full load and moves with load,

g.desc: short to 15 mA / 0.05 W (22R would dissipate 0.5 W in an 0603). VEXC sags to ~2.94 V at full load and moves with load,
